name: Yorktown Teen Travel Camp
description_short: Town travel camp for students in grades 6 to 9 that meets Monday to Thursday at George Washington Elementary School in Mohegan Lake and takes daily trips to amusement and entertainment spots such as Lake Compounce, Dorney Park, Six Flags and an adventure park. Admission and transportation are included.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every camper must pass a swim test at Shrub Oak Pool before camp (June 19, 20 or 27, 2026); some trips are water trips.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests by June 1 get 90% of the fee; none after June 2. A $20 processing fee applies to approved refunds and $10 to credits.
notes: Listed 2026 fees: full four week session $1,945, each two week session $1,055, including admissions and transportation. Monday to Thursday, 8:45 am to 3:00 pm, trip times vary. Town and school district residents registered from March 17, 2026; non-residents could register from April 21 if room remained, with a 20% surcharge on listed fees (no non-resident amount is printed). The town says 2027 information comes in January 2027. The Yorktown full day camp is a separate listing.

changes: City set to Yorktown town, the Census county subdivision for this address; Mohegan Lake is its postal town.
for_andrew: Non-residents can join only if room remains, at listed fees plus 20%; the brochure prints no non-resident amount, so the draft shows the listed (resident) fees. Under the 22 November rule the non-resident rate should show; compute 120% or keep as is?
